class.name: NetwDisplayTracks
class.brief_description: Which display channel a track resolves to, by the two names a channel has.

method.name: ambiguous_count
method.description: How many names more than one channel writes. A diagnostic rather than a fault: ambiguity makes a name unanswerable, not a display wrong.

method.name: by_key
method.description: The channel declared under [param key], or [code]-1[/code] when none was.

method.name: by_name
method.description: The channel [param name] addresses, which is the FIRST to claim it, or [code]-1[/code] when none did. A later claimant makes the name ambiguous through [method is_ambiguous] without displacing the answer, so a lookup that was right before a second channel appeared stays right.

method.name: clear
method.description: Forgets every channel and every ambiguity, which is where a rebuild starts. Indices count from zero again, because the caller's row is empty too.

method.name: declare
method.description: Declares one channel and answers its index, counting up from zero in declaration order. A [param key] already declared keeps its channel and claims no second [param name], because the two declarations are one channel described twice.

method.name: is_ambiguous
method.description: Whether more than one channel writes [param name], which is what makes addressing by that name unreliable rather than wrong.
